INSERT INTO blocked_contact_change (
                    user_uuid,
                    user_domain,
                    blocked_at,
                    last_display_name
                ) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
                ON CONFLICT (user_uuid, user_domain) DO UPDATE SET
                    blocked_at = excluded.blocked_at,
                    last_display_name = excluded.last_display_name
